scope: Per-environment backup and in-place restore on one running installation: database rows, auth users and Storage files return exactly to the backup, while other environments keep running. Backups stay on this host; copying them elsewhere is a separate step.

checks.check: a bucket is created through Storage
an object is uploaded through Storage
backup completes while the environment serves
the environment changed after the backup
restore completes and Auth answers again
rows are exactly those at backup time
a row written after the backup is gone
a file deleted after the backup is back
a file written after the backup is gone
the state set aside by the restore is discarded on request
